metas.name: Power Rangers Samurai
metas.description: Five teenagers inherit samurai powers from ancient Japan to protect the world from an army of monsters.

metas.name: Power Rangers Megaforce
metas.description: An evil galactic armada has come to destroy the planet Earth and the newest team of Power Rangers must harness powers from Rangers of the past to stop them as the Power Rangers Megaforce.

metas.name: Power Rangers Dino Charge
metas.description: In prehistoric times, an alien entrusted 10 powerful Energemas to 10 dinosaurs, and these were lost with their extinction. Now an intergalactic bounty hunter seeks to reclaim the Energemas and destroy the Earth.

metas.name: Power Rangers Ninja Steel
metas.description: A new team of superhuman power rangers must work together and use their new ninja powers to prevent evil from dominating the human race and from destroying the planet earth and the universe
